'''Shaleen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who left her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Voss]] to visit the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], where she traded equipment.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaleen appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Voss Equipment Commendations Vendor on Carrick Station, though she was later relabeled as a Level 45 Equipment Commendations Vendor.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors. Like her counterpart [[Vortine]], Shaleen was not given an actual Voss name with a suffix.<ref name="TOR" />
